title: cutover(ui-merge): build the cutover PR adaptation commit as a measured patch series against the verify tree — lock splice, `ui/` manifests, gate ledgers, skills move, decisions C/F/G1, bill items 1–32 (parent #25677, #25752 step 4)
body:
Filing gate ③ + ④: pre-cutover card of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25677. This is step 4's "commit 2" of #25752, split out so a dev seat builds and measures it while the epic PM runs the freeze, the pin bump and the verify refresh in parallel. Deliverable = a patch series the epic PM applies onto the cutover branch, not a PR of its own.

**谁付代价(业务筛):** the cutover PR (`git subtree add --prefix=ui` + one adaptation commit) must read green class-for-class with the last verify run, and the maintainer merges it by hand in one sitting (proposed 2026-10-26 09:00Z). Every adaptation item left out is a red gate in that PR's CI that the maintainer sees and the seat has to explain live; the verify branch #25718 measured each of them over 11 runs (bill items 1–32). Building the series now, in parallel with the freeze, is what lets the sitting happen tomorrow instead of a day later.

## 维护者速读

切换 PR 的第二个提交(适配提交)交给一个席位先做成补丁序列并在合并布局上测量,PM 在冻结后把它贴到切换分支上。内容全部来自验证分支 11 轮的账单(1–32 项)和你已裁的 C/F/G1。不新增决策。

## Inputs (read first)

- The procedure and the bill-made-concrete list: #25752 step 4 ("commit 2 = the adaptation commit") and its "Accepted red classes" section.
- The bill with every measurement: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/5-cutover-bill-notes.md` (items 1–32; 25–32 added today).
- The measured tree: objectstack branch `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r-25697-verify` at 9e37acd126 (= run 8 tree: objectui main of 2026-10-25 ~04:30Z under `ui/`, spliced + deduped lock, exact `@ai-sdk/react` 4.0.121). ⛔ Read-only for you: never push to it. objectui `main` has since merged #13512 (pin 5874d25302, better-auth 1.7.12, `ai` 7.0.118 exact), #13513 (26 warm imports), #13514 (2 skills internal), #13515 (9 duration keys renamed), #13527 (dependabot workflow off); the final pin bump lands at the freeze. Build against 9e37acd126 and say which items you re-verified against a fresh objectui `main` subtree.
- 4a's ui-side patch (`scripts/ui-import/4a-ui-side.patch`, base 9e37acd126, in #25745) is the sibling: ⛔ do not overlap its files (QUICK_REFERENCE release rows, the sync script, `.github/workflows` under `ui/`).

## What to produce

A patch series under `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/cutover-adaptation/` — numbered `NN-<slug>.patch` (`git format-patch` output, one logical item per patch), a `SERIES.md` listing each patch with: bill item(s) / decision it implements, files, the gate it clears, the before/after measurement on the merged layout, and whether it is root-side (applies at the repo root) or ui-side (applies with `git apply --directory=ui` against objectui `main`). Root-side and ui-side patches in separate number ranges. The epic PM applies the series onto the cutover branch after the subtree refresh, so every patch must apply with `git am --3way` on 9e37acd126 + the series before it.

Items (from #25752 step 4; measurement wins over the wording here):
1. lockfile: `scripts/ui-import/splice-lockfile.mjs` then `pnpm dedupe` (5a, items 6/16/28: exact `@ai-sdk/react` 4.0.121 AND exact `ai` 7.0.118, one lock copy each); root `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides scoped so objectui's dependency lines are not rewritten (react-router 7, happy-dom 21). ⛔ never re-run `splice-lockfile.mjs --out` on a spliced base (item 8). Note the lock is the one patch that must be REBUILT on the frozen objectui `main`, so deliver it as a recipe (commands + expected `pnpm dedupe --check` output) as well as a patch.
2. `ui/` manifests: every `@objectstack/*` dependency `workspace:^`; `ui/package.json` whole-suite `test` script dropped (item 4); `ui/turbo.json` parked as `turbo.objectui.json`; QUICK_REFERENCE rows on `workspace:^` (coordinate with 4a's patch: only rows 4a does not touch).
3. gates: `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` accepts objectui's `type-check` spelling for members under `ui/`, remaining findings get ledger rows (item 1); `check:lockfile-integrity` per-package verdict and `check:lockfile-dedupe` from the workspace root (items 6/7); root `build` filter `!./ui/apps/site` if still needed after A2 (item 3).
4. census: `packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts` — `OBJECTUI_CENSUS` constant becomes a live `LEDGER` row for `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` (`analytics.query`, production consumer), count 28 → 29 (item 17).
5. skills catalog: `ui/skills/objectui` → root `skills/` (decision C, item 18) — ⛔ `skills/**` is Tier H; keep this as its own patch and flag it in SERIES.md.
6. decisions carried: root `eslint.config.mjs` global `ignores` gains `ui/**` with the config's own census comment (G1, item 25); `check:test-source-alias` vitest-alias half scoped to non-`ui/` members (F, item 21d; the clocked half is already fixed by #25781); `check:dts-closure` expands `*` subpath patterns against dist (item 22); `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` stops reading JSX text as a comment opener, pinned self-test (item 23); `check:adr-anchors` allowlist rows for the `ui/**/CHANGELOG.md` ADR-0075 lines (item 19); `check:undeclared-dep-imports` ledger row for `ui/apps/console/src` with the bundled-SPA evidence (item 20); watch-hint / population declarations list `ui/**` (item 21a: `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:turbo-task-graph`, `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`, `check:merge-driver`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files` floor, `check-closing-keyword-parity` ui parsers); `ui/.objectstack-pin/**` deleted (item 21b); `check:agent-test-spelling` `COUNTER_EXAMPLE_FILES` gains `{ path: 'ui/AGENTS.md', reason }` (item 21c amendment); `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` excludes members under `ui/` (run 4 note, with item 2 above).
7. Anything else the merged-layout gates print that is not in the accepted-red-classes list of #25752: measure, fix if mechanical, otherwise list it in SERIES.md as a new class for the epic PM to rule.

## Acceptance

- On 9e37acd126 + the full series: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 0; `pnpm type-check` (root turbo) and the gate families #25752 names exit 0, or the residual is exactly the accepted-red-classes list; `pnpm lint` (root, `--no-inline-config`) 0 errors; `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:turbo-task-graph`, `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`, `check:merge-driver`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files`, the envelope census test, the JSX-mask self-test: each exit 0 with the before/after in SERIES.md.
- `git am --3way` of the whole series on a fresh worktree at 9e37acd126 succeeds; the lock recipe reproduces the lock patch byte-for-byte on that base.
- Report: SERIES.md + one `post-stamped` comment on this card with the table; no PR.

**Size:** L (many small mechanical items, each measured). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none. **Responsibility:** n/a — epic step.

## 风险

- The lock patch goes stale the moment objectui `main` moves; hence the recipe. The ui-side manifest patch may conflict with #13515/#13512's manifest lines; build it against a fresh objectui `main` subtree if you can, and say so.
- `skills/**` and `AGENTS.md` are Tier H: patches touching them are flagged, never folded into another patch.

## Dedupe

The epic's family only (#25752 step 4 is this work; #25753 aftercare takes what is not needed for the sitting). **New** as a card: the procedure card deliberately kept the adaptation commit for the seat; it is split out now for parallelism under the maintainer's 13:39Z freeze ruling.
